name: Gabriel Peredo-Albornoz
abstract_title: THE PAKASQA NUNA INTERFACE: THE SUBCONSCIOUS NEUROPHILOSOPHY OF THE ‘UNSEEN WORLD' FROM THE LAW OF ORIGIN OR FIRST LAW
abstract: This transdisciplinary study bridges neuroscience, neurophilosophy, and Indigenous Knowledge Systems to propose a new model for understanding the subconscious and its alterations. We introduce the Quechua concept of Pakasqa Nuna—the subconscious or “hidden spirit”—as a crucial interface for accessing the “unseen world” (Eddington, 1929) of spiritual and subtle energies (Sugano et al., 1994).
